title: The Bait
text: The quarry is too wary to be caught by chance. It has circled your camp three nights running and left nothing but tracks. It might come to bait, the old hunters say, if the bait were living, and warm, and a little hurt.

options.label: The hardiest plays the bait, bleeding a little into the dark to draw it out.

outcomes.text: It comes out of the dark for the warm one, hungry and careless, and the rest of you are waiting.

options.label: Buy a goat off a hermit and stake it out, sparing your own blood.

outcomes.text: It works. The goat does not mind as much as you do, and nobody watches what happens to it.

options.label: Wait it out, however long it takes. Even a wary thing grows hungry.

outcomes.text: Days pass, and the nights pass longer. It comes in its own time, on its own terms, when you are at your most tired.
